supports: Use recent activity and available time to constrain an aerobic starting point.
Use completion and RPE as feasibility signals for weekly review.
goals.next_evidence_action: Collect SportRX completion, RPE, dropout-reason, and retest data under a defined consent protocol.

supports: Use FITT-VP to represent aerobic dose.
Treat interval and continuous training as selectable methods, not a universal hierarchy.
does_not_support: HIIT as the default for every user.
goals.next_evidence_action: Validate SportRX aerobic progression against completion, session RPE, and like-for-like field retest data.

supports: A complete general-fitness plan should eventually manage multiple training modes.
Aerobic and resistance training can coexist in a weekly plan.
does_not_support: Calling the current aerobic-only output a complete general-fitness prescription.
Ignoring same-session tradeoffs when power is the primary outcome.
goals.next_evidence_action: Define and simulate a separate multi-component pack before enabling full general-fitness automation.

supports: Track weekly sets per muscle group, load, repetitions, and estimated RIR.
Do not require momentary failure on every set.
does_not_support: Automatic hypertrophy dosing from a goal label.
Guaranteed muscle gain or a universal maximizing volume.
goals.next_evidence_action: Define beginner scope, exercise-pattern prerequisites, set-volume start and progression rules, then run simulated and real usability review.

goals.label_zh: 减少脂肪并改善体成分
supports: Combine aerobic and resistance training as distinct dose components.
Track body-composition outcomes separately under consistent measurement conditions.
does_not_support: A calorie-deficit estimate or nutrition prescription.
goals.next_evidence_action: Define a non-nutrition body-composition pack and validate measurement consistency before enabling automated training.

supports: Route to measured Benchmark data before comparing strengths and gaps.
Keep missing dimensions as Not tested.
does_not_support: A tailored Starter Path without enough measured dimensions.
goals.next_evidence_action: Collect protocol-consistent SportRX retest data before defining meaningful-change thresholds.
